scope: Public website only. This contract has no account, patient, clinical, booking or payment access. It is used only on the signed-out website; native patient assistants keep their existing contract.
label: MyThuso website guide · no sign-in needed
welcome: Hello, I’m GilbertOne. I can explain MyThuso and help you find information on this website. Choose a question below or type a MyThuso question.
privacy: Please do not share personal or health information. This chat stays in this page’s memory and is cleared when you reload. Nothing you type here is sent to an AI service.
refusal: I can only answer approved questions about MyThuso and mythuso.co.za. I cannot give medical advice, access accounts or records, make bookings or payments, or answer unrelated questions. Please choose a question below.

questions.question: What is MyThuso?
questions.answer: MyThuso is a planned nurse-led home healthcare service from Akhanya IT Innovations in Johannesburg. The design brings a registered nurse to your home, with doctor review where needed. This website currently shows a preview, not a live care service.
questions.linkLabel: Read how MyThuso is designed to work

questions.question: What services are planned?
questions.answer: The website describes planned home-care services such as routine nursing visits, chronic checks, wound care and sample collection. These are preview offerings; this chat cannot arrange care.

questions.question: Can I book or sign in yet?
aliases: can i book or sign in yet
questions.answer: The website is a preview. Real sign-in, bookings and payments are not connected. Choosing a role opens a simulated workspace, not an authenticated account. The status page explains what is connected and what still needs to be built.

questions.question: Where can I see prices and plans?
aliases: where can i see prices and plans
questions.answer: The website shows catalogue prices and planned care plans. Read them on the website for the current figures; they are not a booking quote or a live payment offer. MyThuso is being designed so that medical aid is not required.

questions.question: Where can nurses learn more?
aliases: how can i join as a nurse
who would come to my house
questions.answer: The website describes the planned nurse pathway and required checks, including South African Nursing Council registration. A preview profile does not establish that a real nurse has been verified or assigned to you.

questions.question: What about privacy and safety?
aliases: what happens to my health information
questions.answer: This website guide cannot access health records or accounts. It does not submit your messages to a server or save them after a reload. The website describes planned safety requirements; the status page explains which services are not connected.
